name: ClickCurac Reservations – Restaurant Table Booking
author: clickcurac

sections.description:
Let your customers book a table directly on your restaurant website, with no commission per guest. ClickCurac Reservations adds a complete restaurant reservation system to WordPress: an online table booking form on your site, confirmation and reminder emails, and a reservation book on your phone.

ClickCurac is an online reservation service for restaurants, bistros, brasseries, bars and cafés, designed in France and hosted in the European Union. This plugin connects your WordPress site to your ClickCurac account and shows your reservation form on the page of your choice (usually “Book a table”).

  • Booking form on your site: date, number of people and time, with your opening hours and the seats you open for each slot.
  • No commission: a fixed monthly price, whatever the number of reservations.
  • Reminder the day before: your customers receive a confirmation email, then a reminder with a link to cancel.
  • Large groups on request: you accept or decline in one tap, the customer is notified by email.
  • Table plan (optional): each reservation gets its table automatically.
  • Your colours: the form follows the colours set in your ClickCurac account.
  • Works with any editor: a native block for the block editor, and the [clickcurac_reservation] shortcode for Elementor, Divi, the classic editor and other page builders.

Reservations are managed in your ClickCurac account, on your phone, tablet or computer.

Levels, prices and current offer: ClickCurac online reservations (30-day free trial, no commitment).

En français

Réservation de restaurant en ligne, sans commission : vos clients réservent leur table directement sur le site de votre restaurant. Formulaire de réservation avec vos horaires et vos places par créneau, e-mail de confirmation et rappel la veille, groupes à valider, plan de salle en option. Créez votre compte ClickCurac depuis l’extension (ou reliez votre compte avec un code de connexion), puis ajoutez le bloc « Formulaire de réservation ClickCurac » ou le shortcode [clickcurac_reservation] dans votre page « Réserver ». Fonctionne avec l’éditeur de blocs, Elementor, Divi et l’éditeur classique.

Niveaux, prix et offre du moment : réservations en ligne ClickCurac (30 jours d’essai gratuit, sans engagement).

External services

This plugin relies on ClickCurac (https://clickcurac.fr/), a third-party online reservation service for restaurants operated by ClickCurac (France). A ClickCurac account is needed: it is a paid service, with a 30-day free trial and no commitment.

  • When you create your ClickCurac account from the plugin (Settings → ClickCurac → Create my account), the plugin sends the details you entered (restaurant name, your name, email, optional phone and city), the address of your site and a random secret to https://backoffice.clickcurac.fr/api/public/v1/checkout. ClickCurac emails you a link to confirm your address and choose your password. Until then, each time you open Settings → ClickCurac, the plugin asks https://backoffice.clickcurac.fr/api/public/v1/wordpress/status (with the secret only) whether your account is ready, then connects your site.
  • When you connect your site (Settings → ClickCurac → Connect), the plugin sends the connection code you pasted and the address of your site to https://backoffice.clickcurac.fr/api/public/v1/wordpress/connect, so that your site is allowed to show your booking form. It receives the name and address (identifier) of your restaurant.

  • On the pages where you add the booking form, your visitors’ browsers load the form script from https://backoffice.clickcurac.fr/widget.js. It reads your opening hours and available slots from ClickCurac, and sends to ClickCurac the reservations made by your customers (name, email, phone, number of people, date, time, message).

  • Only if you click “Try it with a fictitious restaurant” on the settings page, the real booking form of a fictitious demo restaurant is loaded from https://clickcurac.fr/reserver/.

Nothing is sent before you create your account or connect your site, and the plugin sets no cookie.

  • Terms of sale: https://backoffice.clickcurac.fr/legal/cgv
  • Privacy policy: https://backoffice.clickcurac.fr/legal/confidentialite
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin, then open Settings → ClickCurac.
  2. New to ClickCurac: fill in the short form and click “Create my account”. Confirm your email address and choose your password: your site connects itself the next time you open Settings → ClickCurac.
  3. Already a ClickCurac customer: in ClickCurac, open Reservations → Settings → On your website → WordPress, click “Create a connection code”, paste it in Settings → ClickCurac and click “Connect”.
  4. Edit your “Book” page and add the “ClickCurac booking form” block, or paste the [clickcurac_reservation] shortcode.
sections.faq:
Do I need a ClickCurac account?

Yes. You can create it directly from the plugin settings, for free: no subscription is opened. You then choose your reservations plan in ClickCurac, with a 30-day free trial, without a credit card.

Is it a full restaurant reservation system?

Yes. Your customers book online on your site; you see and manage every reservation in ClickCurac (confirm, decline, mark as arrived or no-show, add phone bookings), with your opening hours, closures and the number of seats you open for each time slot.

Can customers also book from Google?

Yes. ClickCurac gives you a booking link to add to your Google Business Profile (Google Maps), leading to the same reservation form.

Is there a commission on reservations?

No. ClickCurac reservations have a fixed monthly price, whatever the number of reservations or guests.

Does it work with Elementor, Divi or the classic editor?

Yes: paste the [clickcurac_reservation] shortcode in a shortcode or text element.

Where do I set my opening hours and available seats?

In your ClickCurac account (Reservations → Settings). Changes appear on your site immediately.

The connection code does not work

A code is valid for one hour and can be used once. Create a new one in ClickCurac and paste it again.

Does the plugin set cookies?

No.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Create your ClickCurac account directly from WordPress: your site connects itself once your email is confirmed.
  • You choose your reservations plan yourself in ClickCurac (30-day free trial): no subscription is opened when the account is created.
  • Settings page preview: a screenshot of the real ClickCurac booking form.

1.0.0

  • First version: connection code, booking form block and shortcode.
